principle: Use AI where ambiguity exists, deterministic systems where truth can be calculated, and humans where judgment, risk and accountability require them.
evidence_limitations: Authoritative supplied files describe a synthetic 250-case sample; annualization is an assumption, not observed annual operations.
All seven diagnosis findings F1-F7, conflict C1 and process step P5 are covered. Recommendations remain INFERRED.
Source-derived baseline 71952 hours differs from rounded source-backed headline 72000; both are retained explicitly.
Known source ambiguities: exact $50000 approval boundary and case MRG-2026-0139 disputed-component reconciliation remain open.
source-backed evaluation artifacts are isolated assessment material, not mapping evidence or a new source-backed model benchmark.
No causal savings, deployment approval or operational execution is established.

opportunities.proposed_intervention: Retrieve authorized records by stable identifiers; summarize and link relevant passages; analyst verifies sufficiency.
opportunities.classification_reason: An LLM can interpret varied documents; connectors should perform exact retrieval. A unified evidence checklist may solve part of the problem without AI.
opportunities.prohibited_action: LLM must not invent missing receipts, silently select conflicting terms, or certify evidence as authoritative.

opportunities.title: Contract applicability support
opportunities.proposed_intervention: Extract candidate clauses with citations and dates; deterministic filters enforce verified supplier, SKU, shipment/geography, scope and effective periods. AP may apply clear contractual terms; Procurement resolves conflict, uncertain authority, disputed interpretation or material precedent. Approved rules enter a versioned registry.
opportunities.classification_reason: Language interpretation benefits from AI support. Only approved, unambiguous rules may enter a versioned rule registry. Do not route every clear term to Procurement: commercial policy section 10 permits AP to apply clear terms. Historical cases must use the policy effective for their dates; do not retroactively apply the March 2026 policy.
opportunities.prohibited_action: No model-selected binding interpretation when execution status, applicability, or amendments conflict.

opportunities.title: Component reconciliation and calculations
opportunities.proposed_intervention: Propose line/component extraction; human confirms disputed components and governing terms; deterministic service calculates supported/unsupported totals.
opportunities.classification_reason: Ambiguous component interpretation differs from arithmetic. Calculations require fixed precision, units, currency and reproducible inputs.
opportunities.prohibited_action: No LLM arithmetic as system-of-record amount; no splitting the original dispute to reduce approval authority. In MRG-2026-0139, invoice components total $75000 while the header states $48088.38 disputed; supported items total $69000 and freight $6000. The scope relationship is not explained. Require case-owner reconciliation before computing a disputed adjustment or approval route; do not overwrite the original amount with either total.

opportunities.title: Escalation routing and decision briefs
opportunities.proposed_intervention: Rules route known triggers; AI drafts the evidence brief; analysts can escalate any risk; accountable specialists decide.
opportunities.classification_reason: Routing can be mechanized while risk assessment remains with people. Escalation frequency alone does not show waste.
opportunities.prohibited_action: Never suppress an escalation because the model is confident; never optimize escalation count as the sole KPI. NorthStar requires Procurement consultation before final communication for rejection above $100000, material historical-treatment change, or disputed promotion interpretation. Fraud/sanctions/litigation/regulatory concerns route immediately to Finance/Legal/Compliance; tax ambiguity routes to Tax.

opportunities.title: Resolve Solara 2026 freight authority gap
opportunities.proposed_intervention: Procurement owns obtaining executed documentation or an authorized documented decision, with Legal confirmation as required by C1; records scope and effective date; keeps case pending until authority exists.
opportunities.classification_reason: This is missing commercial authority, not a text-generation problem. No LLM is necessary to decide treatment.

Do not silently revert to FCA or apply the unsigned 4% fee/$1000 threshold; the expiry clause, continuation email and unsigned draft require Procurement / Legal confirmation together.
